data.name: Neeta
data.gender_notes: Neeta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Neeta originates from Sanskrit, where it means 'nectar' or 'sweetness'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, is often referred to as Neeta, symbolizing the sweetness of knowledge and enlightenment. The name Neeta carries the meaning “Nectar, Sweetness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neeta usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar, sweetness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neeta total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
